greeting.note: {hello} is 'Good morning'/'Good afternoon'/'Good evening'. {who} is ', Storm' (comma included) or empty. Every variant must still read right when {who} is empty. Use {hello} in at least 10 variants.

goodbye.orig: See you later! I'll keep an eye on things.

daysUntil.note: {count} like '41 days' or '1 day'; {thing} like 'christmas'; {when} like 'Friday, December 25'

romanRange.orig: Roman numerals only go from 1 to 3,999.

randomNumber.note: {low}..{high} is the range they asked for

timerSet.note: {label} is usually 'Timer' or a name like 'Pizza'; {duration} like '5 minutes'

timerNoAlerts.orig: Notifications are off, so keep Ace open to see it finish.

alarm.orig: Apps can't set iPad Clock alarms, but I can set a timer or a reminder that rings. Try "remind me at 7am to get up".
alarm.note: Keep both facts: apps can't set Clock alarms; a timer or a reminder works. Keep an example command in quotes in most variants.

recipeNotFound.orig: I couldn't find a recipe for {dish}. Try another name, like "pancakes" or "chicken curry".

weatherAskCity.orig: Which city should I check? Say "weather in" and your city, and I'll remember it.

weatherFail.orig: I couldn't get the weather for {city} right now.

weatherToday.note: {rain} is ', 40% chance of rain' (comma included) or empty

batteryUnknown.orig: I can't read the battery right now.

batteryCharging.orig: Your battery is at {pct}% and charging.

batteryFull.orig: Your battery is at {pct}% and full.

batteryLow.orig: Your battery is at {pct}%. Time to plug in soon.

storageUnknown.orig: I can't read storage right now.

storage.orig: You have {free} free out of {total} ({pct}% free).

storageLow.orig: That's getting low. Offloading unused apps in Settings > General > iPad Storage helps.
storageLow.note: Keep the Settings > General > iPad Storage path.

memoryUsage.orig: Your iPad has {ram} of RAM. I'm using {app}, and about {free} more is free for me. iPadOS doesn't let apps see how much other apps use.

offline.orig: You're offline right now. I can still answer from my answer bank.

noPhoto.orig: Send me a picture with the photo or camera button first, then ask.

noNameYet.orig: You haven't told me your name yet. Say "my name is ...".

recallMissing.orig: You haven't told me your {what} yet. Say "remember my {what} is ...".

recallNothing.orig: I don't have anything saved about you yet.

recallHeader.note: A list follows on the next lines, so end with a colon.

forgotNothing.orig: I didn't have anything saved about that.

pcNotPaired.orig: I'm not connected to your PC. Turn on PC Sync in Settings and pair with Nimbus first.

pcAppNotPaired.orig: I can only {action} apps on your PC once PC Sync is paired with Nimbus.

pcAppDone.note: {action} is a bare verb like 'open' or 'close'; keep it as a verb, e.g. 'I asked your PC to {action} {app}.'

pcAppOnIPad.orig: On iPad, apps can't {action} other apps. You can swipe up from the bottom to switch or close apps. If you pair me with Nimbus, say "{action} {app} on my PC".

pcStatusOff.orig: PC Sync is off, so I can't see your PC. You can turn it on in Settings.

tellMoreWhat.orig: More about what? Ask me something first.

tellMoreFail.orig: I couldn't find more about {topic} right now.

correctionSaved.orig: Thanks for fixing that. I'll say "{fix}" next time.

correctionAsk.orig: Oops. What should I have said?

taught.orig: Learned it! When you ask "{question}", I'll say "{answer}".

taughtAnswer.orig: Got it. Next time you ask "{question}", I'll say: {answer}

reminderSaved.orig: I'll remind you to {task}{when}. It's in the Nimbus list in Reminders.
reminderSaved.note: {when} is ' tomorrow at 5 PM' (leading space) or empty. Keep that it's in the Nimbus list in Reminders.

reminderSet.note: {when} is ' tomorrow at 5 PM' with a leading space, so write {task}{when} with no space between

reminderWhen.orig: When should I remind you? Try "remind me to {task} at 5pm".

calendarWhen.orig: When is it? Try "add soccer practice to my calendar tomorrow at 4pm".

calendarAddAsk.orig: Want me to add "{title}" {when} to your Nimbus calendar?
calendarAddAsk.note: {when} like 'tomorrow at 4 PM'. Must stay a yes/no question.

eventNotFound.orig: I couldn't find an event called "{what}".

eventFound.note: {change} like 'move it to Friday at 3 PM' or 'rename it to "Practice"'. Must stay a yes/no question.

deleteNotFound.orig: I couldn't find "{what}" on your calendar.

nothingComingUp.orig: Nothing coming up in the next 30 days.

calendarFree.orig: Nothing on your calendar {label}. You're free!

calendarList.note: {count} like '3 things'; {list} like 'Soccer at 4 PM, Dinner at 6 PM, plus 2 more'

guess.note: Said before a best-guess answer, so it's one short sentence.

dontKnow.orig: I don't know that one yet. You can teach me by saying "the answer to {question} is ...", or I can search the web.
dontKnow.note: Keep the teach-me example with {question} in quotes.

clarify.note: Asked when two answers fit. Must stay an either/or question.

followUpLost.orig: What are we talking about? Ask me the whole question and I'll answer it.
followUpLost.note: Said when someone asks 'what about it' with nothing before it.

summon.note: Said when someone just says Ace's name. {who} is ', Storm' or empty.

modelMissing.orig: LFM3 Omni isn't on this iPad yet, so Normal Ace answered. You can download it in Settings.
modelMissing.note: Said once, after Normal Ace answers, when LFM3 Omni is picked as the brain but not downloaded. Must mention LFM3 Omni and Settings.

homeOn.note: Said after turning a light, plug, switch or fan on in Apple Home. Short.

homeOff.note: Said after turning a home device off. Short.

homeLevel.note: Brightness was set. {level} is a number, keep the % sign right after {level}.

homeTemp.note: Thermostat target was set. {temp} already has its unit, like 70°F.

homeStatus.note: Reports a device's state. {state} is a phrase like 'on', 'off', 'at 40%' or 'set to 70°F'. Use it after 'is'.

homeList.note: Lead-in before a list of devices. {count} is like '6 devices'. Ends with a colon.

homeScene.note: An Apple Home scene (like Good Night) was run.

vacuumStart.note: Robot vacuum was told to start cleaning.

vacuumRoom.orig: Starting {device}. Apple Home can't pick rooms, so pick the {room} in the MOVA app if it cleans the whole house.
vacuumRoom.note: Vacuum started but Apple Home can't choose one room. Mention the MOVA app and {room}.

vacuumDock.note: Vacuum is going back to charge.

vacuumMissing.orig: I can't find a vacuum in Apple Home. In the MOVA app, add it to Apple Home with Matter, then ask me again.
vacuumMissing.note: No vacuum in Apple Home. Must mention the MOVA app, Apple Home and Matter.

homeNotFound.orig: I couldn't find {device} in Apple Home.
homeNotFound.note: No accessory matched. Can suggest checking the name in the Home app.

homeNoAccess.orig: I need Home access first. Turn it on in the Settings app, under Ace.
homeNoAccess.note: Home permission was denied. Must say where: the Settings app, under Ace.

homeNoHome.orig: There's no home in Apple Home yet. Set one up in the Home app first.
homeNoHome.note: No HomeKit home exists. Mention the Home app.

homeFailed.orig: {device} didn't respond. Check it's powered and connected in the Home app.

homeSafety.orig: For safety, use the Home app for locks, garage doors and alarms.
homeSafety.note: Ace won't control locks, garage doors or security systems.

homeConfirm.note: Asks before acting when Ace isn't sure which device was meant. Must be a yes or no question. {action} is a verb phrase like 'turn on'.

homeCancelled.note: User said no to a home action.

homeCantDo.note: The device doesn't support that command through Apple Home. {action} is a verb like 'pause'.

homeColor.note: Lights were set to a color. {color} is a plain color word like 'red' or 'warm white'.

homeAddTip.orig: {device} isn't in Apple Home yet. Add it to Apple Home from its own app, then I can control it.
homeAddTip.note: For brands Ace can't reach directly (like Blueair or SmartHQ). Must mention Apple Home and its own app.

lanNone.orig: I can't find any Govee or Twinkly lights on your Wi-Fi. In the Govee Home app, turn on LAN Control for each light, then scan again in Settings.
lanNone.note: No Wi-Fi lights found. Must mention Govee, Twinkly, LAN Control and Settings.

voiceNoPermission.orig: I need the microphone and speech recognition to listen. Turn them on in the Settings app, under Ace.
voiceNoPermission.note: Voice permission missing. Must say the Settings app and Ace.

voiceDidntHear.orig: I didn't catch that. Hold the orb and try again.
voiceDidntHear.note: Speech recognition got nothing. Mention holding the orb.

heyAceOn.orig: Okay! Say "Hey Ace" any time while I'm open.
heyAceOn.note: Hands-free wake word turned on. Must include "Hey Ace" in double quotes and say it only works while the app is open.

heyAceOff.orig: Okay, I stopped listening for "Hey Ace".
heyAceOff.note: Hands-free wake word turned off. Must include "Hey Ace" in double quotes.

focusStart.orig: Focus time! {minutes} minutes on the clock. I'll show it on my orb.
focusStart.note: Focus timer started. {minutes} is a number. Mention the orb.

focusDone.orig: Focus time's up. Nice work! Take a short break.
focusDone.note: Focus timer finished. Encouraging, one exclamation mark at most.

focusStopped.orig: Okay, I stopped the focus timer.

focusLeft.note: How long is left. {time} is like '12 minutes'.

recipeIdeas.note: {dishes} is a list like 'omelette, quesadilla or mac and cheese'

recipeNoIdeas.orig: I don't have a recipe that uses {items} yet. Try naming a dish, like "recipe for pancakes".

recipeIdea.orig: How about {name}? Here's how to make it.

focusNone.orig: There's no focus session running. Say "focus for 25 minutes" to start one.

aliasIs.note: {alias} is a name the user gave something, like 'Mova'; {thing} like 'vacuum'

weatherDay.note: {day} like 'Tomorrow' or 'Saturday' (capitalized, can start a sentence); {sky} like 'partly cloudy'; {rain} is ', 40% chance of rain' (comma included) or empty and must come right after {low}

weatherTooFar.orig: I can only see about a week ahead, so {day} is too far away for now.

recipeNeedOne.orig: Ask me for a recipe first, then I can change it for you.

recipeScaled.orig: Here's {name} for {people}. I changed all the amounts.

recipeBatch.orig: Here's {name} with {amount}. I changed all the amounts.
recipeBatch.note: {amount} like 'twice as much' or 'half as much'

recipeGuessedServings.orig: The recipe didn't say how many it feeds, so I guessed 4.

recipeTweaked.note: {change} like 'vegetarian' or 'spicier'; {swaps} is a list like 'chickpeas or tofu instead of the chicken and vegetable broth instead of the meat broth'

recipeTweakNothing.orig: {name} doesn't need changes to be {change}, so you can make it as it is.

scriptFound.note: {title} is the script's name, lowercase, like 'kill brick' or 'tic-tac-toe for two players'; {language} is 'Lua' or 'C++'. A code card with a Copy button follows.

scriptNotFound.orig: I don't have that script yet. I do have {examples}.
scriptNotFound.note: {examples} is a list like 'kill brick, moving platform or coin pickup'

scriptNeedOne.note: They asked for a script without saying which. {examples} is a list joined with 'or'

scriptList.orig: I have {count} scripts built in, like {examples}. They're all in Settings under Scripts.
scriptList.note: {count} like '35 Lua'; {examples} is a list joined with 'and'

translated.note: {phrase} is the English, {text} is the translation in its own script (like こんにちは). A card shows how to say it and a Say it button.

translateUnknown.orig: I don't know how to say "{phrase}" in {language} yet. I know everyday words and phrases like {examples}.
translateUnknown.note: {examples} is a list like 'hello, thank you or where is the bathroom'

translateLanguages.orig: I can translate everyday words and phrases into {languages}.
translateLanguages.note: {languages} is a list of 12 language names joined with 'and'

triviaStart.orig: Let's play! {count} questions about {topic}. Tap an answer or say A, B, C or D.
triviaStart.note: {topic} is a category like 'space' or the word 'everything'. The first question follows in the same message.

triviaWrong.note: {answer} like 'B: Mars'; {fact} is a full sentence

triviaDone.orig: That's the end of the round! You got {score} out of {total}. Say trivia to play again.

triviaStopped.orig: Okay, we'll stop there. You got {score} out of {total}.

twentyStart.orig: Think of an animal, food, place or thing, and I'll guess it in 20 questions. Answer yes, no, maybe or I don't know.
twentyStart.note: The first question follows in the same message

twentyQuestion.note: {question} is a yes or no question like 'Is it alive?'

twentyWin.orig: I got it! It was {thing}, in {count} questions.

twentyWrongGuess.orig: Hmm, not that one. Let me keep going.
twentyWrongGuess.note: Ace guessed wrong and keeps asking; the next question follows in the same message

twentyLose.orig: You win! I'm stumped. What were you thinking of?
twentyLose.note: Ace used all 20 questions or ran out of ideas

twentyLearned.orig: {thing}! Good one. I'll remember it for next time.

twentyStopped.orig: Okay, game over. We can play again anytime.

homeworkSteps.orig: Here's {problem}, step by step. The answer is {answer}.
homeworkSteps.note: {problem} is a math problem like '2x + 3 = 11'. The steps are shown in a card under the message.

homeworkHelp.orig: Send me a math problem like {examples}, or take a photo of your worksheet, and I'll show every step.
homeworkHelp.note: {examples} is a list like '2x + 3 = 11, 3/4 + 1/8 or 15% of 80'

homeworkCantSolve.orig: I can't do that one step by step yet. I can do {kinds}.
homeworkCantSolve.note: {kinds} is a list like 'arithmetic, fractions, percents and equations like 2x + 3 = 11'

photoMathOne.orig: I found a math problem in your picture: {problem}. The answer is {answer}, and the steps are below.

photoMathMany.orig: I found {count} math problems in your picture. The steps for each are below.

noteSaved.note: They said something like 'take a note: buy glue'

noteList.orig: You have {count} notes. The newest ones: {notes}.
noteList.note: {notes} is a list of the newest few notes in quotes

noteListEmpty.orig: You don't have any notes yet. Say "take a note" and what to write.

noteNotFound.orig: I couldn't find a note about "{words}".
noteNotFound.note: They asked to delete or find a note that doesn't exist

notesCleared.note: They asked to delete every note

voiceSpeedSet.note: {speed} is 'a bit slower', 'a bit faster' or 'at my normal speed'

voiceSpeedLimit.orig: That's as {speed} as I can talk.

shoppingAdded.orig: Added {count} ingredients for {recipe} to your {list} list in Reminders.
shoppingAdded.note: {list} is the Reminders list name like 'Shopping'

shoppingSkipped.orig: {count} of them were already on the list, so I left those.
shoppingSkipped.note: Follows shoppingAdded or shoppingAddedItems in the same message

shoppingNoRecipe.orig: Ask me for a recipe first, then I can put its ingredients on your shopping list.
shoppingNoRecipe.note: No recipe has been shown yet

shoppingNoAccess.orig: I need to use Reminders for that. You can turn it on in Settings, then Privacy, then Reminders, then Ace.

triviaNewBest.orig: That's a new best in {category} trivia: {score} out of {total}!
triviaNewBest.note: Said after the round score when this round beat their old best. {category} like 'Space' or 'mixed'

triviaBest.orig: Your best in {category} trivia is {best} out of {total}.
triviaBest.note: Said after the round score when they didn't beat their best

triviaStreak.orig: That's {count} right in a row in {category} trivia!
triviaStreak.note: A streak of right answers, said at 3, 5, 10 and every 5 after

triviaRecords.note: {records} like 'Space 5 out of 5 (best streak 7) and Animals 3 out of 5 (best streak 3)'

triviaRecordsEmpty.orig: You haven't finished a trivia round yet. Say trivia to play one!
triviaRecordsEmpty.note: Asked for trivia scores with none saved

callStarting.orig: Calling now! Talk to me like a phone call.
callStarting.note: A voice call with Ace is starting (the call screen opens). Short and upbeat.

callAlready.orig: We're already on a call. Go ahead, I'm listening.
callAlready.note: You asked to start a call but one is already going. Say Ace is listening.

callNotOn.orig: We're not on a call right now. Say "call Ace" to start one.
callNotOn.note: You asked to hang up but there's no call. Must include "call Ace" in double quotes.

callBye.note: You asked to hang up a voice call. Ace says bye, then the call ends.

callHello.note: The call just connected. {who} is ", Name" or empty, put right after the greeting word.

callStillThere.orig: Still there? Say something, or I'll hang up in a bit.
callStillThere.note: Nobody has talked on the call for a while. Ask if they're there and say Ace will hang up soon.

callQuietBye.orig: It got quiet, so I'm hanging up. Call me any time!
callQuietBye.note: Nobody answered "still there?", so Ace ends the call.
